model: ROLEX Datejust 41 126331 (41 mm steel and Everose Rolesor, fluted Everose bezel, slate dial with green Roman numerals, Cyclops date, Jubilee bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Datejust 41 FOLLOWER of the 126334 template (geometry, step and kit preset unchanged; this variant: slate dial with green Roman numerals, Everose bezel and centre links from the photo, five-column Jubilee bracelet, rose-gold hands traced by a colour test in a variant prep copy): case and lugs from the photo silhouette, polished flange + chamfer + 74 real flutes (148 flat facets with the photo's zig-zag in / out outline), domed crystal, Cyclops date lens, traced hand outlines, fluted crown and the three-column Jubilee bracelet at the photo's joints; dial, indices, print, date numeral, rehaut engraving and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.215 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 905, lug bottom y 1980, crown rows take the mirrored left flank); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: boundary k = 0..147 counter-clockwise from 12 o'clock; long boundaries (odd k: one is exactly at 9 o'clock) reach r 17.41..20.06 mm, short ones 17.59..19.90 mm; flange 15.98..17.08 mm

lens.note: Cyclops: outline = trace.lens_mm (rim outer edge, barrel shaped, about 7.6 x 5.9 mm), rim chamfer 0.18 mm then a flat top inset 0.55 mm; shows the projected photo of the lens

hands.note: hands = traced photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons; the lume, black facets and polished edges stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Datejust crown (no guards): flutes x 1409..1459, cap to 1474, axis 0.52 mm below the pivot

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind. A Jubilee: columns outer / semi / centre / semi / outer, 4 boundaries per bounds row, pieces and z_semi per kind.

bracelet.note: Jubilee: outer (brushed steel) / semi (polished Everose) / centre (polished Everose) / semi / outer. Joint rows (px, 22.215 px/mm, pivot (960, 1424)) = the centre of the dark gap line before each new lit face of the polished columns, the sharp upper edge of the next piece for the outer links; outer top 905 / 807.5 / 730 / 685.7, end 674.5; semi top 863 / 771.5 / 711.5; centre top 908 / 813.5 / 736.5 / 693.5; outer bottom 1980 / 2106.7 / 2226.7 / 2333.3 / 2421.7 / 2490, end 2525.5; semi bottom 2072 / 2188 / 2289 / 2371 / 2447 / 2500, end 2530; centre bottom 2013 / 2118 / 2236 / 2320.5 / 2412 / 2502, end 2525.5; column lines x 860.2 / 926.5 / 992.8 / 1059 (top), 859.5 / 926 / 993 / 1059.5 (bottom). Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
